required_contexts: verify.py aggregate in the flat exec-mirror shape
_note: Every job in .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs on a pull request, plus every required Python runtime child of each Gate shard, by exact check-run name. Workflows' Maint 71 reads this file from main and blocks declared failures; because it reports an absent name as never started rather than enforcing it, the Gate summary separately fails unless all twelve shard/runtime artifacts exist. tests/test_delivery_required_contexts.py keeps both surfaces exact.
